OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.name: Gu Refinement
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.descriptio: First select 1 eligible Gu Worm. If it is mortal, you may then select 1 additional mortal Gu Worm; if it is immortal, only that 1 Gu Worm can be refined this time. Each selected Gu Worm gains one rank, including rank 5 to rank 6. Confirming with 0 selected cancels. Each rest site allows one successful refinement.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.selectionP: Select the first Gu Worm to refine. A mortal Gu Worm allows one additional mortal selection; an immortal Gu Worm is refined alone.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.name: Gu Fusion
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.description: Choose one or more Gu cards and click Confirm manually. The selection limit is determined by currently craftable recipes. Materials are consumed only when both their types and quantities match a recipe. A failed attempt does not consume the use. Fusion can succeed once per rest site.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.selectionProm: Choose fusion materials, then click Confirm. The required count depends on the recipe.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.secondMort: You selected a mortal Gu Worm. Select 1 additional mortal Gu Worm, or confirm with 0 selected to refine only the first.
